_for_consumers: Promotion into a game remains your call. 'accepted' means one named person accepted this into pdoom-data's curated set. It does not mean verified, endorsed, or game-ready, and there is no game_facing flag here.
_shape: Neutral. No impacts, rarity, pdoom_impact or reaction text. This collection is NOT event_v1 and does not claim to be -- event_v1 requires those fields, and ADR-001 says they are on the wrong side of the boundary (pdoom-data#34).
